blockers.summary: The repository still has no canonical Vossie product and 177-screen specification package. The approved Expo foundation may proceed, but marketplace feature planning cannot be completed without inventing requirements.

decisions_required.question: Provide the canonical Vossie specification package (177-screen map, screen specs, architecture/data decisions) by committing it to the repository (e.g. docs/specs/) or linking the authoritative source (e.g. Figma file URLs).

Confirm the application stack/tooling for the adaptive single-deployment PWA (framework, package manager, hosting). Supabase is referenced by AGENT-CONTRACTS.md; the frontend framework and deployment target are not yet approved in-repo.
decisions_required.resolution: The project owner approved Expo SDK 57, React Native Web, Expo Router, strict TypeScript, npm, and the EAS delivery path in ADR 0001.
